questions.question: Test Pyramid — tại sao unit tests nhiều hơn E2E tests?

options.A: Unit: fast, isolated, cheap. E2E: slow, brittle, expensive. Nhiều unit tests → fast feedback loop

questions.explanation: Pyramid: nhiều unit (fast, cheap) → ít integration → rất ít E2E (slow, expensive, brittle). Ice cream cone anti-pattern: ngược lại. Unit test: ms. Integration: giây. E2E: phút.

questions.question: Mock vs Stub vs Spy trong testing?

options.A: Stub: canned response. Mock: verify interactions. Spy: wrap real object, track calls

questions.explanation: Stub: return predefined value, không verify. Mock: verify calls (was method called? with what args?). Spy: wrap real implementation, can verify calls. Fake: lightweight implementation (in-memory DB).

questions.question: Playwright vs Selenium — ưu điểm của Playwright?

options.A: Auto-wait, network interception, multiple browsers in 1 API, faster, built-in trace viewer

questions.explanation: Playwright: auto-wait eliminates flakiness, network/mock API built-in, codegen, trace viewer, screenshot/video recording. Selenium: mature ecosystem, supports more languages. Playwright preferred for new projects.

questions.question: Page Object Model (POM) trong E2E testing là gì?

options.A: Design pattern: encapsulate page elements và actions trong class → test code không phụ thuộc selectors cụ thể

questions.explanation: POM: LoginPage class với properties (locators) và methods (login(), getError()). Tests call page methods, không biết implementation. Khi UI thay đổi: chỉ sửa POM class, không sửa tests.

questions.question: Postman environment variables dùng để làm gì?

options.A: Tách config (URL, token) khỏi collection — switch giữa dev/staging/prod mà không sửa requests
options.D: Không có tác dụng thực tế

questions.explanation: {{baseUrl}}, {{token}}: reference variables. Environments: dev (localhost:3000), staging (api.staging.com). Collection Variables: shared trong collection. pm.environment.set() trong scripts để dynamic values.
